tagline: STFT spectral freeze with blur, shift, stretch, gate and morph
description: SpectralFreeze runs a 2048-point FFT with a Hann window and 75% overlap, and can hold the current spectrum at the level and pitch it had. Blur, stretch, shift, gate, phase randomize, morph and a low/high cut then reshape the spectrum, frozen or live. A scrolling spectrogram shows the result, and six factory presets demonstrate the effects.

features.name: Freeze
features.description: Holds each bin's magnitude and keeps advancing its phase at the rate measured just after freezing, so the held sound keeps its pitch and level

features.name: Spectral effects
features.description: Blur (Gaussian smoothing over up to 11 bins), Stretch (spreads the spectrum upward by up to 5x), Shift (moves every bin up or down by up to 100 bins), Gate (silences bins below a share of the loudest), Randomize (scrambles phase)

features.name: Morph
features.description: While not frozen, crossfades the live spectrum toward the last frozen one

features.name: Low Cut, High Cut and Dry/Wet
features.description: Zeroes bins outside 20 Hz to 20 kHz limits you set, and blends the processed signal with the dry input

features.name: Spectrogram
features.description: Scrolling display coloured by level from blue to red, with the frozen spectrum overlaid, redrawn 60 times a second

features.name: Six factory presets
features.description: Init, Frozen Blur, Spectral Stretch, Frequency Shifter, Spectral Gate and Granular Texture, plus a quick-save slot

useCases: Hold a moment of a sound as a sustained texture
Keep only the strongest partials with Gate
Inharmonic, metallic tones with Shift or Stretch
Band-limited textures with Low Cut and High Cut
Noisy, smeared versions of a sound with Randomize and Blur
